plugins.name: diablo4-helper
plugins.description: Diablo 4 gameplay helper - verifies every version-specific answer against live sources instead of a stale training cutoff. Ships researched references for itemization, the damage model, Horadric Cube recipes, Tuning Prisms and per-slot affix pools, a goal-driven crafting decision tree, and Barbarian/Whirlwind data; plus a diablo.trade client that ranks listings by enchant cost. Understands the D4Companion overlay.
